supersedes.reason: web/app.js changed (drawn SVG icons replacing Unicode subject and status marks); the same route, viewport, figure, hash, lightbox, mesh and assessment checks were re-run against the changed file with tools/check_cervical_browser.cjs.
resolved_defects: Shared lesson initially mounted three held remote RA thumbnails; integrating agent replaced them with exact registered licensed originals and restarted curriculum cache.

native_reference.note:
Original HRA female pelvic source excerpt · partial reference · 3D anatomy
SOURCE ANATOMICAL MESHES

54 complete original HRA female-assembly mesh occurrences: ovaries, tubal parts, uterine regions, source ligaments/folds, vagina, bladder regions, ureters, rectum/sigmoid and selected pelvic bones. Source labels, open surfaces and shared uterus-wall triangles are preserved. This curated reference is independent of the published MRI cases and current patient. Endometrium, myometrium, junctional zone, bowel-wall layers, nerves, parametrial boundaries, lesions and surgical margins remain unverified. Native declared metres/Y-up are retained; patient axes, acquisition calibration and MRI registration are unverified. The older standalone uterus provenance conflict is retained below.
